The '''Piryn Shar sector''' was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Natalon system/Legends|Natalon]], [[Noe'ha'on system/Legends|Noe'ha'on]], and [[Ohratuu system/Legends|Ohratuu systems]], with the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] passing through the former two [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. The Ohratuu system contained a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Ohratuu|same name]], while the Natalon system was the origin point of the [[Natalon Core Bandits]]. [[Noe'ha'on/Legends|Noe'ha'on]] was a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] world that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Noehon]]s and the [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]] creatures.

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Noe'ha'on was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], although off-worlders had already visited the world [[3630 BBY|millennia earlier]]. [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] forces and those of the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]] traveled through the Piryn Shar [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively. Between [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Reesen Jivrak]] established a base on Ohratuu.

==Description==
The Piryn Shar [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the sector bordered the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]] in the [[spinward]] direction and formed a four-way border with the [[Har Worlds]], the [[Trans-Jardeen sector/Legends|Trans-Jardeen sector]], and the [[Vatha sector/Legends|Vatha sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]]. Together with the Har Worlds and the Vatha sector, the Piryn Shar sector also formed the Expansion Region's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] boundary with the [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan]], [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure]], and [[Wornal sector/Legends|Wornal sectors]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="ExpansionRegion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref>

The [[Natalon system/Legends|Natalon]], [[Noe'ha'on system/Legends|Noe'ha'on]], and [[Ohratuu system/Legends|Ohratuu systems]] all lay in the Piryn Shar sector.<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]]<ref name="Great Gran Run" /> passed through the Natalon and Noe'ha'on systems on its way from the Vatha sector to the Har Worlds.<ref name="ExpansionRegion" />

==History==
As part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] traveled along the section of the<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Great Gran Run passing through the Piryn Shar sector<ref name="Great Gran Run" /> prior to the [[Battle of Halm|battle]] in the Mid Rim's [[Halm system/Legends|Halm system]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Similarly, while moving Coreward as part of secondary movements of their [[Nagai–Tof War|separate invasions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the forces of the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]] moved along<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Piryn Shar sector's segment of the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route.<ref name="Great Gran Run" />

==Locations==
===The Natalon and Ohratuu systems===
The Natalon system was the origin point of the [[Natalon Core Bandits]].<ref name="ValentineStory">''[[A Valentine Story]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Natalon Core Bandits]]|system=[[Natalon system/Legends|Natalon system]]|legends=1}}</ref> At some point between [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was involved in a [[Lightfight|shootout]] in the system.<ref name="TEA" />

The Ohratuu system contained<ref name="EAOC" /> a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Ohratuu|same name]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a species of docile land-based herd creatures known as [[deripor]]s.<ref name="Toria">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}</ref> At some point between [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}, which is set during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], states that [[Science Research Droid]]s were introduced shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' further dates that battle to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and also establishes that the Rebel Alliance transformed into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Per "Toria Tell's Droid Journal," [[Reesen Jivrak]] employed a Science Research Droid on [[Ohratuu]], therefore he must have established his base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] at some point between 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] and 4 ABY.</ref> the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Reesen Jivrak]] and his small group of followers established a base on Ohratuu. Jivrak utilized deripors altered by strength-increasing and aggression-heightening [[Poison/Legends|toxins]] in hit-and-run attacks.<ref name="Toria" />

===Noe'ha'on===
{{Main|Noe'ha'on/Legends}}
The [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] world [[Noe'ha'on/Legends|Noe'ha'on]]<ref name="UAA" /> was located in the eponymous system.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the homeworld of the [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slug]],<ref name="CSWE klorslug">{{CSWECite|II|222|k'lor'slug}}</ref> a species of aggressive, [[Worm/Legends|worm]]-like [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Diet/Legends|predators]]<ref name="RPG2ERE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> that eventually found their way off-world as pests.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|K'lor'slug}}</ref> Noe'ha'on was also inhabited by the [[Noehon]]s, a species of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tree/Legends|arboreal]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]].<ref name="UAA" />

The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Noe'ha'on was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> although off-world [[paleontologist]] expeditions had already visited the world<ref name="Fossil Records">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Fossil Records}}</ref> by [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="Date KotET">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} &mdash; According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] take place in [[3630 BBY]]. The Crew Skill mission "Fossil Records" is part of the ''Knights of the Eternal Throne'' expansion and therefore also takes place in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Noe'ha'on fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of that conflict, the [[Nineteenth Army]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was tasked with defending the system's vicinity against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Between 19 BBY and 17 BBY, Noe'ha'on was incorporated into the territory controlled by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Piryn Shar sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares J-16 and K-16.<ref name="ExpansionRegion" />
